x-provider-evidence.note: Input schema as published in the OpenAPI document embedded in the Replicate model page; description limits are enforced separately by application policy.

first_frame_image.description: First frame image for video generation. The output video will have the same aspect ratio as this image.
first_frame_image.title: First Frame Image

last_frame_image.description: Last frame image for video generation. The final frame of the output video will match this image.
last_frame_image.title: Last Frame Image

ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Ignored for image-to-video, which uses the aspect ratio of the input image.
ratio.title: ratio

reference_audio_urls.description: Public URLs for up to 3 reference audio clips.
reference_audio_urls.title: Reference Audio Urls

reference_image_urls.description: Public URLs for up to 9 reference images.
reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls

reference_video_urls.description: Public URLs for up to 3 reference videos.
reference_video_urls.title: Reference Video Urls
